capabilities: Render the active note's headings and indentation as an interactive mindmap in the sidebar
Edit the map (rename, add, outdent, delete, drag to re-parent) to rewrite the note
Create a linked note from a selected node, optionally from a template
Render code blocks, math, tables and callouts as read-only cards on the map
Export the full map as SVG
extras: Desktop-first: it loads on mobile but the gestures are designed for mouse and trackpad. Installable via BRAT before community-plugin listing; requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. Makes no network requests and has diagnostic flicker-log commands for bug reports.
motivation: Existing mind-map plugins either export snapshots or store the map in a separate file that silently drifts from the note; the author wanted the note itself to be the single source of truth.
problem: Most mind-map plugins export a static snapshot or keep the map in a separate file that drifts out of sync with the note.

relations.evidence: markmap — the layout and rendering engine (MIT).

summary: Mindmap view that draws the active note's headings and indented lines as an interactive XMind-style map and writes map edits back to the same Markdown file.
